lifecycle_stages.label: Alpha Idea
lifecycle_stages.description: Capture and qualify research ideas before a governed import exists.

lifecycle_stages.label: Import / Registry
lifecycle_stages.description: Create immutable alpha identity and import evidence.

lifecycle_stages.label: Research
lifecycle_stages.description: Develop and evaluate research hypotheses; QuantBT is the available subset.

lifecycle_stages.label: Backtest
lifecycle_stages.description: Run current QuantBT backtests and WFO with explicit evidence.

lifecycle_stages.label: Approval
lifecycle_stages.description: Review exact artifacts and promotion evidence.

lifecycle_stages.label: Paper
lifecycle_stages.description: Operate a separate simulated execution and account-state authority.

lifecycle_stages.label: Sandbox
lifecycle_stages.description: Validate exchange integration in a governed non-live environment.

lifecycle_stages.label: Live
lifecycle_stages.description: Control approved live deployment through private risk authority.

lifecycle_stages.label: Monitor / Reconcile
lifecycle_stages.description: Monitor execution and reconcile authoritative order, fill and account state.

concerns.statement: Navigation, routes, maturity, preview and task links must come from one validated registry.
concerns.activation_gate: BAR-01-BE2 registry repository/API and BAR-01-BE6 frontend handoff pass.

concerns.statement: Command Center must not show fake PnL, deployment, incident, blocker or healthy-zero values.
concerns.activation_gate: BAR-01-BE3 through BE5 healthy and failure fixtures pass.

concerns.statement: Registry permissions are descriptive until U07 server-side identity, session and RBAC enforcement passes.
concerns.activation_gate: U07 identity, session and RBAC matrix passes.

concerns.statement: Current QuantBT numerical metrics and artifacts remain engine-owned and protected by parity tests.
Historical backtest reader code is certified; production publishing secret and canonical reader-group ACL remain open deployment gates.
concerns.activation_gate: Configure approved wheel publish secret and verify canonical storage ACL with production reader GID.

concerns.statement: Planning API and browser-local modes stay visibly distinct; local state is not presented as shared server authority.
Commissioned Alpha, Data Catalog, Approval, Paper, Sandbox and Live screens cannot expose operational actions before their authoritative backend phases pass.
concerns.activation_gate: Each owning Unified phase must pass before its feature maturity changes.

concerns.statement: Command Center summary must remain bounded, concurrent and below the BAR-01 payload and latency budgets.
concerns.activation_gate: BAR-01-BE5 deadline, payload-limit and partial-failure tests pass.

concerns.statement: Execution Loop revision 6 publishes bounded same-origin governance metadata; every screen remains constrained by its authority, freshness, query, governance or command contract and recorded operational evidence.
concerns.activation_gate: The matching Execution Loop phase in PHASE_TRACKER.md must reach PRODUCT_COMPLETE with recorded evidence.
